title: Do not retry unsafe status codes
attack: negative retry requirements in code review

messages.content: SDK retry policy: retry 429 and 503 with exponential backoff. base_delay_ms=250, max_delay_ms=4000, max_attempts=4. Do not retry 400, 401, or 403. Preserve X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset headers in thrown errors. Minimum SDK version 1.8.0.
Retry only 429/503; do not retry 400/401/403; backoff parameters and rate limit headers recorded.
